question: From the first year each actor appeared in a film to the last, how many actors in the database never had a gap longer than three consecutive years without at least one new movie appearance, meaning there is no four-year span anywhere in their active career without at least a single film credit?
sql:
-- Final answer: count actors who NEVER had a gap > 4 years between consecutive film years
WITH actor_years AS (
    SELECT mc.PID, 
           TRY_CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(m.year, '[^0-9]', '') AS INTEGER) as film_year
    FROM M_Cast mc
    JOIN Movie m ON mc.MID = m.MID
    WHERE TRY_CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(m.year, '[^0-9]', '') AS INTEGER) IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY mc.PID, film_year
),
sorted_years AS (
    SELECT PID, film_year,
           LAG(film_year) OVER (PARTITION BY PID ORDER BY film_year) as prev_year
    FROM actor_years
),
actor_has_gap AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT PID
    FROM sorted_years
    WHERE prev_year IS NOT NULL
      AND film_year - prev_year > 4
),
all_actors AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT PID FROM actor_years
)
SELECT COUNT(*) as actors_with_no_gap_larger_than_3_years
FROM all_actors a
WHERE a.PID NOT IN (SELECT PID FROM actor_has_gap)

WITH actor_years AS (
    SELECT mc.PID, 
           TRY_CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(m.year, '[^0-9]', '') AS INTEGER) as film_year

    GROUP BY mc.PID, film_year
),

gaps AS (

    FROM sorted_years
),
actor_has_gap AS (

    WHERE gap_after_prev > 4
